authority: public vault payload source for HOMESERVER /vault/scripts runtime payloads
install_method: chrysalis packs this repository; target unpack moves/copies payload into /vault/scripts

consumers.deployables: birth-time pack/unpack of this repo into /vault/scripts after Keyman and sudoers exist
consumers.harmonia: post-birth payload drift check and refresh of /vault/scripts
consumers.caduceus: runtime actuator may call declared scripts through sudoers policy but does not own payload text

encryption_boundary.legacy_bootstrap_meaning: legacy mode ran cryptsetup luksFormat on /dev/disk/by-partlabel/homeserver-vault using /root/key/skeleton.key, opened homeserver-vault_crypt, mkfs.ext4, then mounted /vault
encryption_boundary.modern_bootstrap_meaning: non-legacy mode expected the vault partition to be preseed-configured and already mounted or mountable by partlabel
encryption_boundary.finale_cleanup_meaning: later finale rotated/verified a LUKS vault from the deploy ephemeral key to /root/key/skeleton.key
encryption_boundary.desired_chrysalis_boundary: vault module should create/verify LUKS on homeserver-vault when safe/unformatted, open it with redacted Keyman skeleton authority, create filesystem if newly formatted, mount /vault, then move this payload into /vault/scripts

notes: This repo is payload authority only; vault partition formatting/mount policy belongs to the deployable/Harmonia storage module.
Keyman owns secret material; this repo must not carry keys, passwords, deploy tokens, or decrypted exchange files.
The first placement preserves quarry parity; later tranches may split VPN/NAS/storage tools into narrower repos if earned.
